question: Which products have the highest customer review ratings?
grader_notes: Ambiguous review_ids are excluded correctly, but product_reviews uses DISTINCT product_id, order_id, review_score and drops review_id, so two distinct reviews with the same score on one order collapse into one contribution (affects 62 product counts, e.g. 154e7e31… 246 vs reference 248). Declared minimum = 10 reviews, outside the frozen 20–100 range, which fails result and transparency by rule. Order-level attribution disclosed; the significance caveat is missing.

question: Which sellers are associated with the lowest customer review ratings?
grader_notes: Threshold 20 declared; seller grain and order-level attribution stated (transparency pass). order_reviews_clean averages reviews per order_id before averaging per seller, merging distinct review_ids (affects 65 seller counts, e.g. cc419e06… 1,638 vs reference 1,645). Reference re-run at n>=20: ranks 1–8 match; ranks 9–10 reversed (54965bbe… 3.0274 shown before dc8798cb… 3.0250) because averages were rounded to 2 dp before ORDER BY (secondary 'other'). Caveat says association, not causation, but does not note that reviews also reflect delivery and platform experience.
